Equal exact sphere second moments 64/315 and zero cubic moments force identical exact volume and surface-area polynomials, while mean width=2 by zero average. Independent direct polynomial sphere moment computations verified Ef⁴=4096/36465, Eg⁴=241664/2501499 and gap 65536/4169165>0. Independent spherical-Hessian tensor identities verified ∫det(Aq)=−9∫q² and ∫qdet(Aq)=136∫q³ for these examples. Positivity of I+eps Aq for eps sufficiently small establishes smooth strict convexity. Width=2+2eps q then has different fourth centered moment, so laws differ.
